notes: The class carries the Casimir as a label coordinate (coefficient ring Z), so the flavoured trace lives on the SQED_2 realisation (next rows); K4/K5 are checked there.  The bar involution here is antimultiplicative and fixes K (a false friend of the literature).

the Casimir is central: χ_1 commutes with E, F, K
E_{a,b} = q^-ab E^a K^b and F_{a,b} = q^ab F^a K^b (E^a K^b = q^ab E_{a,b}), a <= 3, |b| <= 3
pure powers: E^a = E_{a,0}, F^a = F_{a,0}, K^n K^m = K^{n+m}
rho(K) = K^-1, rho(E) = q^-1 F K^-1 = F_{1,-1}, rho(F) = q K E = E_{1,1}, rho fixes χ_1
rho has infinite order (Lusztig's braid): rho^k(E) distinct for k <= 12, alternating F_{1,-(2m+1)} and E_{1,2m}
rho covers the Weyl reflection: rho^2(K) = K, rho^2(E) = E_{1,2} = q^-2 E K^2 (not E)
